# Step AD: several scripts

Lex (2026-11-19, Orbit TOOLS-358, prototype TOOLS-356 approved in its final state): while I write one script, my AI works on others. Switching stays in the file name's menu, with no tabs and no side-by-side view. Each script keeps its scroll place and caret. While the AI works in another script, that menu row shows a spinner and "AI working"; when it is done, the row gets an orange dot (no number) and "AI done", and the same dot shows on the file name. The open script never gets a dot. A click opens the script at the change, lightly marked, with Undo on the agent's tag; the dot goes once the change has been seen. The dot stays clearly apart from the orange "not saved yet" dot by its position, as in the prototype.

## What it does

- **Scripts kept aside** (`public/aside.js`, new, pure). Leaving a script (any way: the menu, Open a script, New script, the agent's `open_script`) keeps where it was scrolled and its caret (by line and offset, so it also fits the script read again from its file). When the agent still works on an ask on selected words there (waiting or taken; not B-roll asks, not whole-script jobs), or it holds an agent change not seen yet, the script itself stays in the tab's memory: its document, asks and undo steps. Only a script in a file (on the computer or in the browser) is kept, since the answer must reach its file.
- **The answer lands there.** `wait_for_asks` hands the agent the asks of scripts kept aside too, each with its script's `fileName`; `answer_ask` for one of them (an ask on selected words; a whole-script job or a B-roll ask there is told to wait until the person opens that script, and stays as it is) is checked as usual against that script and lands in it as in the open script (step F): one undo step for when the person is back, lightly marked, Undo on the agent's tag; a note waits beside its text; links go in as for a selection. Other open asks and earlier marks in that paragraph follow the change. Nothing in the open script is touched: no render, no caret, no scroll, no undo step, no room message.
- **Its own file.** `saving.saveLeft` (new in `saving.js`) writes the kept script's words to its own file with the auto-save rules: no permission prompt, and the changed-on-disk check. While a save runs it waits in the queue like any script left behind (`SaveQueue.queueLeft`), after an older write of the same file, and is compared with what that write left. A file changed elsewhere is never written over. `on.left` tells the app what a left file now holds, so the next write and the reopen compare with the right words. A kept script writes no draft (see "Two scripts with the same name" below).
- **Opening it again.** From the menu (or any other way) a kept script takes no answer while it opens (the agent hears it is opening and to answer again in a moment), leaves the list once its file has been read, and opens as it is in memory, with its undo steps, after its last write has landed, unless its file holds other words by then: then it opens from its file like any other. An answer that could not be written because the file had changed shows there as "Unsaved changes" (Restore brings it back); words the agent already saved that someone wrote over later are gone, as for any saved file. With a change not seen yet it opens at that change (30 % from the top), otherwise at its scroll place with its caret. A change counts as seen once it has been on screen below the top bar; leaving before that keeps its dot.
- **The menu and the dot** (prototype, final state). A kept script's row shows a small spinner and "AI working" while the agent works there, then "AI done" and an orange dot; the open script's row never has either. The same dot sits at the file name's top corner (`#aiDot`, 0.62 rem, raised by 0.38 rem, with a ring in the page colour) while any kept script is done and not seen; the "not saved yet" dot stays 7 px, beside the name, outside the button. Screen readers hear "AI done in another script" on the dot and "<agent> is done in <file>" once (a polite live region). The spinner and the dot's arrival move only when motion is allowed.

- **Taken off the list.** Deleting a kept browser script drops it from memory (its dot goes); its writes on their way, the agent's and the save made when it was left, end first and none follows, so no draft comes back under its name (second look on PR #76). Taking a kept file off the switcher's list with ×, or a kept file falling off the list of 20, drops it from memory too; its file stays, and answers already on their way still reach it one after the other. A "/" command being typed when the script is left stays out of it, as it stays out of every save.
- **Opening twice at once** (review round 2): while a kept script opens it takes no answer, and a second open of it (the person's click while the agent's `open_script` runs) waits for the first; the agent's `open_script` for a script the person opened meanwhile says it is already open and reads nothing again (round 3).
- **A Save as at the same moment** (review round 1, P2): a Save as or a save into the browser that runs while an answer lands in a kept script now writes that script's words to its own file before it ends; before, the queue was cleared and opening that script waited for good.

- **Its own save still waiting** (second look, P1): a script left while its own auto-save runs has its newer words waiting for that save; an answer that lands then is newer still and wins, so the older words never overwrite it (`SaveQueue.queueLeft`). A `saveLeft` call hears it is done only from the write of its own words (or newer ones merged into them), never from an older write of the same file still on its way (second look on 97954a7, P1). A change, or a caret, in the folded lines at the top opens them when the script opens there (second look, P2).

- **Opens one at a time** (second look on f7f7ce9, P1): every open waits for the one before it. An open that finds its file opened meanwhile by the one before reads nothing again (so the agent's change keeps its undo step), and a script being deleted does not open; the delete waits for every save of it with `saving.idle()` (new). A kept file drops from memory only when it falls off a list that was really read (with storage off, nothing is dropped), and a script deleted while it opens shows no "Couldn't open". Every open checks once more, right before it shows the script, that the file is not being deleted (a script that was not kept too); `idle()` also waits for a `saveLeft` write running outside the queue; and an answer that changes a line a B-roll shot covers gives that shot "Check", as the person's own edit does, through the B-roll part (`touchKept`, seam 2; second look on 437c1d2 and the review on 4a0cb63). Opening a kept script also waits for the save made when it was left; `idle()` waits through a save that was waiting behind the running one; a script left while a "/" command is typed is kept without its undo steps, which may hold parts of the command (as when any script is left; second look on 1068e69).

- **A "/" command when switching through the menu** (lead, 2026-11-19, after the second look on fa89526, P2): focus going to the file-name menu closes the parts menu, but the command typed there is remembered (`commandNow`) while the file-name menu has focus: saves leave it out and auto-save waits, and a script left through the menu leaves it behind, in its file, its kept copy and its undo steps. Anywhere else (back in the text, another button, a click on the page), it is ordinary text again and auto-save starts as usual; closing the file-name menu alone does not end it, since a click on a row hides the menu before the script is left (review on PR #77). The command is found again by its own words, nearest its place, so an agent's answer that moves it while the menu is open (and puts the caret back in its line) does not let it through (second look on PR #77). Typing in the text, or the menu closing with focus outside it, ends it too; a click on a row (or Open a script…, New script) marks a switch on its way, so closing the menu then keeps it (review round 3 on PR #77). Focus moving to another button while the menu stays open ends it as well; only focus put back in the text by an answer landing is ignored (second look round 3 on PR #77). While a switch from the menu is on its way (A still opening), focus moving by itself is ignored too, and a switch that opens nothing goes back to these rules (second look round 4 on PR #77). Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=slash node scripts/smoke-several-scripts.mjs …` (failed on b54e2ee: " /on" reached the file); it also runs at 390 px, where focus stays on the file name.
- **The menu open when an answer lands** (release review on PR #78, P2): only the rows whose state changed get a new end (`refreshRows`, `rowEnd`), in place; the list is not drawn again, so keyboard focus on a row and a mouse press that has started on it stay put. When another script is open by then (the agent's `open_script`), the list is drawn again once, so the checkmark follows (second look on PR #79). Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=focus` (failed on 138c924).
- **Two scripts with the same name** (release review on PR #78, P2; lead's choice B, 2026-11-19): drafts go by file name, and Save to video folder names every script script.md. So a script kept aside never writes a draft at all: not for its asks and marks, not for its "Check" flags, and its background writes never fall back to one (`saveLeft` with `noDraft`). As it goes to the background it leaves no draft either, and an older one under its name is cleared; the save made as it is left, or one of it already running, never falls back to a draft (`on.keepsWords`; review on PR #79, the lead's extra round). Its "Check" flags stay in memory (`keptFlags`) and come back when it opens again from memory. Words of an answer that could not be written (its file changed elsewhere) stay in memory and come along as its "Unsaved changes" when it opens from its file (`keptDraft`). Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=samename` (failed on 138c924: the open script's draft held the other script's words and asks): the open script's draft and "Check" flags stay its own while an answer lands in the other one, also after leaving it for a third script, and Restore gives each script its own words.
  - **Accepted limit** (lead, 2026-11-19): after a reload, a kept script's marks, Undo on the agent's tag and open asks do not come back; its file still has the agent's change. Its words that could not be written are lost with a reload too.
  - **Limit, as before this step:** switching between two same-named scripts by hand still shares one draft name. Keying drafts by each file's own identity is its own card (the lead's option A).
  - **Taken off the list mid-save** (release review on PR #78, P2): the "no draft" choice stays with the file (`keptWords`) after the script leaves memory, until it opens again, so a save still on its way that fails parks nothing under the name. Its words are then lost if that save fails (accepted with choice B). Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=removed`.
  - **Sweep before the release** (lead, 2026-11-19): every draft write or delete by name was checked. All belong to the open script, except a left script's failed saves (now `keptWords`, above) and deleting a browser script: its keys (draft, B-roll list and link) go by name, so a delete now leaves them when the open script is another file of that name. Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=deletesame`.
- **An "AI done" script opened from the Storyboard** (release review on PR #78, P2): it switches to the Script view and opens at the change. Browser check: `SMOKE_ONLY=board`.

## Checks

- `tests/aside.test.mjs`: keeping a script aside, landing a replace (marked, one undo step, the open script untouched), other asks and marks following, a gone quote cancelled, a note, the asks offered to the agent, the caret by line and offset, and the dot's size and place.
- `tests/saving.test.mjs`: `saveLeft` writes with the auto-save rules and says so; waits for a running save and compares with what it left; never writes over a file changed on disk; still reaches its file during a Save as or a save into the browser.
- `scripts/smoke-several-scripts.mjs`: the whole flow in headless Chrome at 1280 px and 390 px with the agent played over `/mcp` and two made-up scripts: the ask, "AI working", typing in the open script while the answer lands (same scroll, caret and text), the file of the other script, the dot (bigger and higher than the not-saved dot), "AI done", opening at the marked change, Undo on the agent's tag, Undo by Ctrl+Z on the phone run, the first script back at its place with its caret, the change still marked after a reload, an answer that meets a file changed elsewhere (not written over; "Unsaved changes" with Restore), and deleting a script the agent just worked in (its dot, row, file and draft go; the agent gets none of its asks). Evidence: `docs/agents/evidence/step-ad-browser.txt`.

- Spec (P3): e58718f:public/app.js:3531 — P3 fault: the step doc (docs/build/step-ad-several-scripts.md:57) says "a switch that opens nothing goes back to these rules". That holds for a row click (public/app.js:3099–3100), but not for "Open a script…". `#menuOpen` sets `menuSlash.switching = true` (public/app.js:3146), and nothing sets it back. `openFile()` returns without opening anything when the picker is cancelled (AbortError, line 2583), when the fallback file input is cancelled, or when `openHandle` returns false (line 2587). Before this round, `switching` only affected the toggle listener. Now line 3531 also ignores every `focusin` while it is set. So: cancel the picker, then Tab to another button or back into the text. The command stays held, it is left out of saves, and auto-save waits until the person types or clicks. It is a rare path (a command still typed, Open a script…, cancel, then moving by keyboard only), and the cost is a delayed save. Fix: in `openFile`, clear `menuSlash.switching` on every path that returns without opening anything. Or have the `#menuOpen` listener do it after `openFile()` settles: `await openFile(); if (menuSlash) menuSlash.switching = false;`. In both cases `openFile` must report whether a script opened (return `openHandle`'s result).

- Standards (P3): 599a71b:public/app.js:3065 — P3 fault (R3-9, still open): Save as from a script.md to another name moves the draft to the new name (`saving.drafts.move(from, to)`). On the path through `public/saving.js:466` it deletes the draft under the old name instead. Either way, `draftOwners` keeps saying the old name belongs to the old handle. Then a script kept aside under the old name (for example, the other script.md, with its agent still working) always finds `owner && owner !== s.handle` in `persistKept` (`public/app.js:2553`). It keeps its draft in memory for good, because `releaseDrafts` only calls `persistKept` again. If the tab reloads before that script is opened, its open asks and the agent's marked changes are lost. It is a rare path (Save as while another file of that name is kept aside) with a small cost. Fix: in `moveKeys`, add `if (draftOwners.get(from)) { draftOwners.set(to, draftOwners.get(from)); draftOwners.delete(from); }`, or simply `draftOwners.delete(from)`, then call `releaseDrafts()`. While at it, clear the owner in `discardDraft` (`public/app.js:2630`) too, so that every `drafts.del` in app.js does the same thing.
- Standards (P3): be5097d:public/app.js:2542 — P3 race (R3-3, still open): unchanged since the last round. Fix as suggested before: check `asides.includes(s)` (or `!s.removed`) next to `!s.gone` before calling `persistKept(s)` in the `.then`.

- Spec (P3): 3555903:public/app.js:3110 — P3 ticket: the step doc now says "a draft moved to a new name (Save as, a browser script following its title) frees the old name for drafts that wait". For Save as this holds, because `on.done(true)` calls `releaseDrafts()`. A browser script that follows its title, though, is renamed inside an ordinary auto-save: `followTitle` → `moveKeys` (`public/app.js:3110`), then `drain(false)` → `on.done(false)` (`public/saving.js:400`, `407`), and `on.done(false)` does not call `releaseDrafts()` (`public/app.js:2782`). So `draftOwners` frees the old name, but nothing waiting for it is written until the next open, leave or answer. If the tab reloads before then, the waiting draft (asks and marked changes included) is lost. It is a rare path: a browser script whose old name is also the name of a kept or closed script with a waiting draft. Fix: call `releaseDrafts()` at the end of `followTitle`, after `state.name = name`. Or call it in `moveKeys` right after the two `draftOwners.delete` lines (`state.name` must already be the new name by then, so the new name stays blocked).
- Standards (P3): 3555903:public/app.js:2575 — P3 race: the new `heldWords` loop in `releaseDrafts` can write another file's held draft under a name in the middle of an open. That happens after `openOne` has already read the owner (`public/app.js:2700-2701`) and before `loadText` reads the draft (`public/app.js:2359`). Releases run in that window: in `dropKept` (`openOne` line 2705) and in `leaveScript` → `dropKept` (`loadText` line 2323). Example: a kept script.md K writes no draft once its last ask is cancelled. `persistKept` then deletes the draft and owner (`public/app.js:2561`) without calling `releaseDrafts()`. A third script.md H has a draft held by its file. Now the person opens another script.md F, or K itself with its file changed elsewhere and `keptDraft(K)` null. `openOne` sees no owner, so `foreign` is false. The release in `leaveScript` writes H's draft under script.md, and F (or K) shows H's words as its own "Unsaved changes". Restore would then save them into the wrong file. It takes three files with the same name and a cancelled ask, so it is rare, but it is the same kind of leak the earlier P1 fixed. Fix: in `loadText`, decide `foreign` again when the draft is read: treat the draft as foreign when `draftOwners.get(name)` is set and is not `handle` (`openOne` has already put the same-file owner on `handle`, line 2708). Or: in `releaseDrafts`, skip any name that `openOne` is opening at the moment (keep that name in a module variable from line 2700 until `loadText` returns).

- Spec (P3): b6c142a:public/app.js:2727 — P3 race: `keepsWords` is checked when the write fails, not when the script is left. Suppose a kept script leaves `asides` while its leave-save or a running save is still in progress. It leaves through "Remove from the list" (`public/app.js:3166`) or by falling off the recent list (`public/app.js:2955`). If that write then fails, the fallback at `public/saving.js:396` or `:332` writes a draft under the shared name after all. The next same-named script then offers it as "Unsaved changes", which is the bug this round fixed. This needs a removal during a write that is still running, and the bread script was just at the top of the recent list, so it is a rare path. Fix: decide when the script is left. For example, keep a `WeakSet` of handles that were left as kept scripts. Add the handle in `leaveScript` and remove it only when `openOne` opens that script again. `keepsWords` would then read that set, or `asides` plus scripts marked `removed`.
